shortBio.en: Pink Floyd guitarist from 1968; sustain lead tone and shared vocals after Barrett.
shortBio.zh: 1968 年起 Pink Floyd 吉他手；延音主音音色，并与 Barrett 之后分担人声。

body.en:
Born 1946, Cambridge. Joins in 1968 as Barrett exits. Lead guitar and shared vocals through the 1970s peak albums.

Continues the band name with Mason (and briefly Wright) after Waters leaves.
body.zh:
1946 年生于剑桥。1968 年 Barrett 离队时加入。1970 年代巅峰专辑的主音吉他与分担人声。

Waters 离队后与 Mason（及短暂的 Wright）继续乐队名义。
